poll.q: Aaj ki sab se bari khabar kaun si hai — Signal ki maths-proof security, Anthropic ka $64bn IPO, ya October mein $3.9bn remittances?
options: 🔐 Signal ki cryptography maths se prove
🏏 Doosra Test smog ki wajah se Rawalpindi shift

https://deepmind.google/blog/introducing.what: DeepMind ke AlphaProof Code ne Signal ke crypto code ki security ko maths se prove kar diya — 6.5 million lines Lean proof, sirf 4 hafton mein. Pehli dafa kisi widely-used protocol ka asal compiled code verify hua, sirf design nahi.
https://deepmind.google/blog/introducing.why: AI ab sirf code likh nahi raha, code ko prove bhi kar raha hai. Agar ye scale hua to banking, power grid aur medical devices ka software bhi isi tarah check ho sakega — security ka naya standard.
https://deepmind.google/blog/introducing.next: Dekhna ye hai ke ye framework Signal se aage kitni jaldi jata hai — aur kya koi doosri company is ko apne products par istemal karti hai ya sirf DeepMind ka demo ban kar reh jata hai.
https://deepmind.google/blog/introducing.take: Meri take: 6.5 million lines proof, 4 hafte — ye number sun kar lagta hai AI ne security research ka saal bhar ka kaam aik mahine mein kar diya. Lekin yaad rakho, ye poori Signal app ka certificate nahi hai — group chats aur key generation abhi bahar hain. Hype ko scope se alag rakhna seekho.

https://deepmind.google/blog/gemini-robo.what: Gemini Robotics 2.5 launch — Apptronik ke Apollo 2 humanoid ne Mercedes ki live factory lines par car parts sort kiye, 96% success. 200+ tasks par 30-100% behtar success, 20-30% tez. ASIMOV-Jailbreak benchmark bhi aaya.
https://deepmind.google/blog/gemini-robo.why: Chatbot wali AI khatam ho rahi hai — ab AI ko haath-pair mil rahe hain. Jo pehle factory floor par robot chalayega, wo agle decade ki supply chain jeetega.
https://deepmind.google/blog/gemini-robo.next: Pilot to pilot hota hai — asal sawal ye hai ke Apollo 2 lines par permanent rehta hai ya demo ke baad wapas lab jata hai. Mercedes ka agla step hi asal khabar hogi.
https://deepmind.google/blog/gemini-robo.take: Meri take: Robot factory mein kaam kar raha hai, ye sci-fi nahi raha — lekin 96% bhi factory ke liye kaafi nahi hota, wahan 99.9% chahiye hota hai. Lab ke numbers aur production ke numbers mein farq hota hai, aur DeepMind ko ye farq abhi bharna hai.

https://www.fool.com/money/buying-stocks.what: Anthropic ne IPO roadshow shuru kar diya: 825M shares, $70-$78 per share, Nasdaq ticker ANT. Pricing 18 Nov, trading 19 Nov expected. Top par $64.35bn raise, fully diluted value ~$1.4 trillion. Retail ko ~20% allocation ka target.
https://www.fool.com/money/buying-stocks.why: AI ki sab se bari IPO hai — ye sirf Anthropic ki kahani nahi, poori AI industry ki valuation ka test hai. Agar ye $1.4 trillion par bik gaya to har AI startup ki keemat dobara likhi jayegi.
https://www.fool.com/money/buying-stocks.next: 18 November ki pricing dekhni hai — aur retail ko waqai 20% milta hai ya sirf headline hai. Book pehle din hi covered batayi ja rahi hai, to demand ki kami nahi lagti.
https://www.fool.com/money/buying-stocks.take: Meri take: $1.4 trillion — aik aisi company ke liye jis ka 9 mahine ka net loss $104bn hai. Ye IPO hai ya AI bubble ka sab se bara test? Retail ke liye 20% allocation achha gesture hai, lekin yaad rakho: IPO mein milne wala share lottery hai, guarantee nahi.

https://techcrunch.com/2026/11/10/openai.what: OpenAI ne 'Businesses in ChatGPT' beta launch kiya — Business Hub mein companies apna verified profile bana sakti hain, product feeds de sakti hain, aur apna Business Agent chala sakti hain. Pehle sirf eligible US ecommerce aur online-service businesses.
https://techcrunch.com/2026/11/10/openai.why: ChatGPT ab sirf jawab dene wala nahi, dukaanein dikhane wala ban raha hai. 1.2 billion weekly users ke saamne aana — ye Google Search ki jagah lene ki koshish hai, seedha seedha.
https://techcrunch.com/2026/11/10/openai.next: Dekhna ye hai ke businesses is par kitna kharch karte hain aur users ko ye profiles helpful lagti hain ya ad jaisi. Aur Pakistan jaisi markets tak ye kab pahunchta hai — abhi to sirf US hai.
https://techcrunch.com/2026/11/10/openai.take: Meri take: OpenAI ne pehle checkout cart wala e-commerce experiment kiya tha, wo fail hua. Ab doosri koshish hai — Google Business Profile ki copy. Copy karna bura nahi, lekin sawaal ye hai: log ChatGPT par dukaanein dhoondhne aayenge ya sirf sawal poochhne? Abhi jawab nahi mila.

https://dataconomy.com/2026/11/10/meitua.what: Meituan ne LongCat-2.5 ke weights Hugging Face par MIT license ke tehat khol diye — 1.6 trillion parameters ka multimodal agent model jo screenshots/video dekh kar multi-step coding karta hai. Terminal-Bench v2.1 par 88.4 score, API $0.30/$1.20 per million tokens.
https://dataconomy.com/2026/11/10/meitua.why: Open weights ki race mein China ab sirf peeche nahi — aik food-delivery company ne 1.6T model khol diya. MIT license ka matlab hai commercial use bhi free, jo open-source community ke liye bari baat hai.
https://dataconomy.com/2026/11/10/meitua.next: Independent benchmarks abhi baqi hain — company ke apne scores par andha bharosa nahi karna chahiye. Aur asal test ye hai ke developers is ko real projects mein istemal karte hain ya sirf download kar ke bhool jate hain.
https://dataconomy.com/2026/11/10/meitua.take: Meri take: Weights kholna achha hai, lekin 3.2TB weights ka matlab hai ke aam developer is ko chala hi nahi sakta — sirf bare players. 'Open' ka matlab ab ye bhi ho gaya hai ke darwaza khula hai, lekin andar jaane ke liye cluster chahiye. Phir bhi, MIT license wali ye move closed models ke liye aik challenge hai.

https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/worl.what: KP administration ne faceless anti-terror courts ka plan banaya — gawah, prosecutor aur judge ki pehchan chhupi rahegi. Police ke liye Rs59.8bn aur CTD ke liye Rs10.3bn saalana, Safe City ki tausia aur anti-drone systems bhi. Sube mein 10,000 se zyada police ki kami hai.
https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/worl.why: Dehshatgardi ke cases mein gawah dar ke mare bolte nahi — ye asal masla hai. Faceless courts is ka jawab hain, lekin ye tab hi kaam karenge jab in ke faislay transparent aur challengeable hon.
https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/worl.next: Amendment kab aata hai aur pehli faceless court kab banti hai — elaan se implementation tak ka waqt hi batayega ke ye plan hai ya sirf briefing hai.
https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/worl.take: Meri take: Faceless courts ka idea samajh mein aata hai — gawah ki jaan bachana zaroori hai. Lekin tareekh batati hai ke jab adalatein 'faceless' hoti hain to sawal uthte hain ke insaaf dikhai bhi deta hai ya nahi. Security aur transparency ka balance hi asal test hai.

https://www.dawn.com/news/print/2043576.what: PCB ne doosra Pakistan-Sri Lanka Test Lahore se Rawalpindi shift kar diya — 17-21 November ka match ab Rawalpindi Cricket Stadium mein hoga. Lahore mein 10 din se shadeed smog, AQI 600 tak. Pehle Test mein Pakistan ne 434/9 declare kiye, Saud Shakeel 93, Sri Lanka 114/3.
https://www.dawn.com/news/print/2043576.why: Cricket bhi ab mausam aur hawa ki khabar ban gaya hai. Smog sirf sehet ka masla nahi — ye sports calendar, tourism aur sheher ki image sab kuch badal raha hai.
https://www.dawn.com/news/print/2043576.next: Rawalpindi mein bhi smog ka season aa raha hai — PCB ko agle saal ke schedule mein November ke matches ke liye backup plan sochna hoga, warna har saal yehi hoga.
https://www.dawn.com/news/print/2043576.take: Meri take: AQI 600 — ye number parh kar bhi agar smog 'seasonal masla' lagta hai to phir kya kahein. Test shift karna sahi faisla hai, lekin asal khabar ye nahi ke match kahan hoga — asal khabar ye hai ke Lahore mein saans lena mushkil ho gaya hai.

https://tribune.com.pk/story/2639562/dar.what: Ishaq Dar ne Margalla Dialogue 2026 mein kaha ke Makkah Joint Defence Agreement defensive hai aur kisi mulk ke khilaf nahi. Unhon ne kaha Pakistan Indus Waters Treaty ke tehat apne paani ke huqooq ki hifazat karega aur paani ko hathiyaar banane ki mukhalfat karega.
https://tribune.com.pk/story/2639562/dar.why: Paani ab sirf paani nahi — ye Pakistan ki zindagi aur India ke saath sab se bara flashpoint hai. Treaty par khara rehna aur us ki khilaf-warzi ka jawab dena, dono aik saath chalte hain.
https://tribune.com.pk/story/2639562/dar.next: Dialogue mein badi baatein to ho gayin — asal test ye hai ke paani ke muamle par practical diplomacy kya nikalti hai, aur minerals forum mein koi asal deal hoti hai ya sirf taqreerein.
https://tribune.com.pk/story/2639562/dar.take: Meri take: Margalla Dialogue mein har saal achhi baatein hoti hain — lekin diplomacy ka score taqreeron se nahi, deals se banta hai. Paani par sakht lehja zaroori hai, magar is ke saath koi thos rasta bhi dikhana hoga.

https://english.aaj.tv/news/330480141/re.what: Overseas Pakistanis ne October mein $3.89bn bheje — 14% izafa. July-October total $14.8bn. Sab se zyada Saudi Arabia se $982m, phir UAE $816m, UK $592m. SBP ne saal bhar ka forecast $44bn se barha kar $45bn kar diya.
https://english.aaj.tv/news/330480141/re.why: Remittances Pakistan ki economy ki sab se bari lifeline ban chuki hain — taqreeban poora external deficit inhi se cover hota hai. Ye awaam ki mehnat hai, hukoomat ki policy nahi.
https://english.aaj.tv/news/330480141/re.next: Sawal ye hai ke ye paisa sirf ghar ke kharchon mein jata hai ya investment mein bhi badalta hai. Overseas Pakistanis ko invest karne ka asaan rasta mile to ye $45bn se zyada bhi ho sakta hai.
https://english.aaj.tv/news/330480141/re.take: Meri take: $3.9bn aik mahine mein — overseas Pakistanis ne mulk ko default se bachaya, aur ab bhi bacha rahe hain. Lekin ye bhi sach hai: aik mulk jo apne logon ki bahar ki kamai par chalta hai, us ko apne andar ki economy par bhi mehnat karni hogi. Remittances lifeline hain, plan nahi.

https://www.dawn.com/news/2043165.what: Pakistan ne SAFF Championship mein Maldives ko 3-0 se hara diya — Najeebullah Bettani ki brace aur McKeal Abdullah ki penalty. India se 3-2 ki haar ke baad ye jeet semi-final ki umeed zinda rakhti hai. Faisla 11 Nov ko India-Maldives match par hai.
https://www.dawn.com/news/2043165.why: Pakistan football ke liye ye aik chhoti jeet nahi — India se haar ke baad team ne comeback kiya. Football mein Pakistan ka naam ab sirf 'participate karne' wala nahi raha.
https://www.dawn.com/news/2043165.next: 11 November ko India-Maldives match dekhna hai — Maldives ko bari jeet chahiye warna Pakistan semi-final mein. Aur phir semi-final mein asal test hoga.
https://www.dawn.com/news/2043165.take: Meri take: 3-0, clean sheet, aur Najeebullah ki brace — ye woh football hai jo fans dekhna chahte hain. India se haar ke baad bhi team ne hausla nahi haara, aur yehi baat sab se achhi hai. Ab semi-final tak ka rasta doosron ke match par hai — thoda ajeeb hai, lekin football mein aisa hi hota hai.

https://www.dawn.com/news/2043358/pakist.what: Pakistan ki tent-pegging team World Championship ke liye Jordan rawana — 11 se 14 November tak. Paanch rukni squad ki qayadat Wajahatullah Khan Awan kar rahe hain, Mianwali mein camp ke baad. Pakistan 2023 World Cup mein runner-up raha tha.
https://www.dawn.com/news/2043358/pakist.why: Tent-pegging Pakistan ka purana khel hai — ghode, neza aur nishana. Ye woh sports hain jin mein Pakistan ki asal pehchan hai, lekin in ki coverage cricket ke muqable mein na ke barabar hoti hai.
https://www.dawn.com/news/2043358/pakist.next: Championship 11 November se shuru — Pakistan ke paas 2023 ki runner-up position se aage jaane ka mauqa hai. Jeet gaye to ye khabar headlines mein aani chahiye.
https://www.dawn.com/news/2043358/pakist.take: Meri take: Cricket ke shor mein tent-pegging jaisi teams chup chaap mulk ka naam roshan karti hain. 2023 mein runner-up — is dafa jeet ka mauqa hai. In players ko bhi wohi izzat milni chahiye jo cricketers ko milti hai.

mood: 🔐 Signal ki maths-proof security, 💰 Anthropic ka $64bn IPO, 🇵🇰 remittances record — aaj AI aur paisa, dono ki race tez hai.
